$comment: 🔮️ Test-only third-party reference of the repo YAML codec. `yaml` is a devDependency of 📦️packages/🟦️typescript and is imported only from 🧪️tests/**; no runtime code may depend on it.

oracles.rationale: A complete YAML 1.2 implementation written by someone else decides what each vector means, so the hand-rolled scanner in this module cannot agree with itself.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: The encoder is deliberately NOT a general YAML emitter: it produces one deterministic, key-sorted subset chosen for diffability, and it renders an empty container as an empty block. No third-party emitter reproduces that subset, so the round trip is held instead by two independently written subjects plus the metamorphic law decode(encode(decode(x))) == decode(x) over the shared vector set.
